Definition
[Busemann sublevel set]

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0323 1. Definition B.58\group comparison-theorems

Given an origin $O\in \mathcal M^n$ and $s\ge 0$, the Busemann sublevel set is \[ C_s\coloneqq \bigcap _{\gamma \in \mathcal R(O)} \mathbb B_{\gamma _s}. \]
